name: Stepwise explanation thread
description: Unpack one idea in a sequence of self-contained posts.
use_cases: Repurpose a guide into a short learning sequence
structure:
1. [TOPIC]: [KEY_INSIGHT]

2 onward. [STEPS]

Optional evidence: [SUPPORTING_EVIDENCE]

Final post. Recap [KEY_INSIGHT]. Optional next action: [DESIRED_ACTION]
customization: Split STEPS into numbered posts with one idea each.
Keep source qualifications beside the claims they qualify.
limitations: Do not assume a fixed number of posts or current character cap.
Do not strip caveats solely to fit a post.
